LightDecoder reads and sends your Gmail over Gmail\'s standard mail access (IMAP and SMTP), the way other mail apps do. It signs in with an app password: a separate 16-letter password just for LightDecoder, which you can revoke at any time.

1. Turn on 2-Step Verification for your Google account, if it is not on yet.
2. Open the app passwords page (button below) and sign in.
3. Name it "LightDecoder" and tap Create.
4. Copy the 16 letters and paste them here.
Stored only on this phone: the app password (encrypted) and the email LightDecoder downloads. Nothing is uploaded anywhere else, and nothing is in backups.
Check for new email in the background
About every 15 minutes while there is a network. Android may wait longer to save battery.
The app password is deleted from this phone. Your email stays in Gmail. To stop the password working anywhere, revoke it on the app passwords page.
